- Vat.Amount -> 39,33
- Vat.Rate -> 20
- GrandTotal.Amount -> 235,98

8) Note formatting for final output:
- Numbers should be represented as numbers (preserve two decimals) and Vat.Rate as number without percent sign per rules. If multiple VAT entries existed, would return arrays; here single group only.
